subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` suppress explicit Gateway control-plane `update.run` managed handoffs, or only configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally separate configured auto-update applies from explicit operator/admin `update.run`; changing that scope affects update policy, restart behavior, and operator expectations.

options.title: Extend the kill-switch to update.run
options.body: Treat the env var as a supervised/headless no-package-restart policy and block Gateway-originated managed `update.run` handoffs before scheduling the restart.

options.title: Keep the current narrow scope
options.body: Document that `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` only blocks configured background applies and that explicit `update.run` remains an operator/admin restart path.

options.title: Add a separate explicit policy
options.body: Keep the current env var narrow and introduce a clearer future policy surface for blocking control-plane package updates in managed services.

recommendation.title: Extend the kill-switch to update.run
recommendation.body: Treat the env var as a supervised/headless no-package-restart policy and block Gateway-originated managed `update.run` handoffs before scheduling the restart.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the kill-switch behavior and has recent updater/restart context around this exact contract boundary.
